summary.intent: Fix a regression where file sizes and modified dates show '...' after a cold start in the CipherBox web app, and add web e2e/smoke coverage so it gets caught in future.
summary.outcome: Found and fixed three engine/web defects (root focus never queued, shared-folder navigation file leg skipped, pre-walk focus raising false abuse), added a cold-start listing smoke spec with three cases, and the full local smoke slice passed. Changes were committed on a fix branch and the push/draft PR was being made.

repo: The web sends focus null for the vault root at /files; the engine treats SetFocus{None} as 'no folder open', so root file rows were never queued and stayed size/mtime None ('...'). Every Rust test used Some(ROOT), masking it.
The sync rung/status ('synced') is stamped from the root leg only; file-leg failures don't affect it, so the status bar can say synced while file rows stay unresolved.
snapshotStore.assertFocus called reportFocus (which triggers a forced manualRefresh in LeaderRelay) before facade.setFocus; the engine runs commands in order so the forced pass saw the old focus.

refresh_focus_on_access deliberately skipped rows belonging to a shared folder's own scope (scoped_to), leaving them for the 30s poll tick; now a per-scope navigation_file_legs runs each scope under its own seed.

start returns before any pass runs; descendant scopes are installed only by walk_scopes, so an early SetFocus on a shared folder read it under the root seed and raised a false AttributableAbuse (adoption gate rejected at grant-section).
Web e2e smoke = every test not tagged @full; new untagged specs join the PR-blocking Web E2E Smoke automatically. FilesPage.cells(name) reads size/modified but no spec used it before.
Local e2e bundle builds need the CI build env (including the Google client id) or smoke tests fail at login; README recipe was updated.
Engine tests: changed cold-tick behaviour required updating three write_plane tests and capstone pass_tick.rs expectations.

code.finding: Calls store.setFocus(route.kind === 'node' ? route.id : null), so /files sends null.
setFocus returns early when the node is unchanged, so the initial null focus never reaches the engine.
refresh_focus_on_access skipped queueing children when folder is None; fixed to use folder.unwrap_or(root).
queue_unprojected_children loop over folders_in_view() had nothing to iterate when open_folder was None; now uses folders_in_view_or_root.
UNRESOLVED = '...' placeholder rendered when child.size/mtime is null.

workflow: Parallel investigation lanes in separate worktrees worked well, but their edits overlap in shared files (facade.rs), so sequencing fix lanes mattered.
A subagent's temporary worktree vanishes; save its failing test diff out before relying on it.
Subagent diff stats can include sibling lanes' edits, making per-lane attribution unclear.
Verify with the whole smoke slice locally after engine changes that affect every cold start.

friction: A response was stopped by a safety classifier mid-investigation and had to be restated without the withheld content.
The first full smoke run had five failures caused by the local bundle lacking the CI build env (Google client id), not by the changes.
Mint-link flow in the shared-folder spec leaves the dialog open and has a 180s timeout exceeding the 120s per-test budget.
The engine lane's guard attempts for the pre-walk focus bug broke six plain-folder cold-start tests, requiring a different design.
Could not reproduce the ~130s tail on staging in the fake world.
open_items: The shared-folder spec case has a timing risk (180s mint timeout vs 120s test timeout) and relies on an unverified assumption that the probe folder ordering publishes the scope cut.
Public Engine::focus_folders() still returns folders_in_view() without the root.
The extra staging 130s delay beyond one poll cadence is unexplained.
Draft PR was being opened; CI results and review still pending.
